'''Moonflower''' is the name of the horse riden by [[Leane Sharif]].

==Activities==
When escaping from the [[White Tower]], Leane takes Moonflower.{{ref/book|5|1}} Moonflower carries Leane from [[Tar Valon]] to [[Kore Springs]] and later to [[Salidar]].{{ref/book|5|26}}
